key_points: Walton family sold $534M of WMT shares, signaling insider skepticism.
Oppenheimer downgraded WMT ahead of earnings, citing weaker outperformance case.
WMT agreed to a $50M DOJ settlement over invalid opioid prescriptions.
Sam's Club launched Predictive Precision Targeting and Vibe.co deal to boost advertising revenue.
Inflation and high gas prices may push consumers toward discounters, potentially benefiting WMT.
